innerError.description: Details about what was wrong with the request, when there are any

jobId.description: ID of the job, a UUIDv7

manifestKey.description: Key of the image's manifest in the variants store

namespace.description: Namespace and ID of the image the job works on

position.description: 0 when the job started right away, its place in the image's queue otherwise

sourceKey.description: Key of the original in the originals store, set for uploads

status.description: Always `queued`: the job runs after the response is sent

error.description: Why the job failed; it starts with `image_not_found` when the image's original doesn't exist

position.description: Place in the image's queue, set while the job is queued

total.description: Number of variants the job generates, and how many are done

namespace.description: Namespace and ID of an existing image

notify.description: Where the job reports its outcome

sourceFormat.description: Format of the original, which is only needed for an image provino has no manifest for: `jpg`, `png`, `webp`, `avif`, `heic`, `heif`

variants.description:
Every variant the image should have, including the ones it already has
Stored files that still match are reused, so sending the whole set costs nothing for the variants that exist

effort.description:
Encoder CPU effort, for AVIF (0-9) and WebP (0-6)
When omitted, AVIF uses 4 and WebP uses 5

fit.description: How the source is mapped onto the box: `contain` (the default) or `cover`

format.description: Format the variant is encoded to: `webp`, `avif`, `jpeg` (or `jpg`), or `png`

quality.description: Encoder quality from 1 to 100, required for every format except PNG

size.description: Box the variant is fitted into; either side can be 0 to leave it unconstrained when the fit is `contain`

context.description: Opaque JSON object that is echoed back in the event, at most 4 KB

endpoint.description: Name of the endpoint in provino's configuration, or empty for the default endpoint

Bearer.description: `Bearer <token>`, where the token is a JWT from the configured issuer or an API key starting with `pvk_`
Bearer.name: Authorization

info.description: HTTP API for uploading images and generating their variants in durable workflows
info.title: provino API

get.description: Returns the status of any job of an image. A queued job reports its place in the image's queue. The status of a finished job is retained for `actors.completedWorkflowRetention`.
get.summary: Get the status of a job

post.description: Queues a job for an image that is already stored. Send every variant the image should have, including the ones it already has: stored files that still match are reused, boxes the original can't fill are skipped, and the rest are encoded. The request is validated and queued without touching storage, so an image that doesn't exist makes the job fail with `image_not_found` rather than this request.
post.summary: Generate variants for an existing image

post.description: Accepts a multipart body with a `metadata` part, a JSON object naming the namespace and optionally the image ID, the variants and the notification, followed by the `image` part. The image's format is detected from its content. The response is sent once the original is stored and its job is queued.

metadata.description: JSON client.UploadMetadata, which must come before the image

post.summary: Upload an image from a backend

get.description: Returns the status of a job the caller started with a browser upload. A job started by anyone else, or through the client API, is reported as not found.
get.summary: Get the status of one's own job

post.description: Accepts a multipart body with an optional `metadata` part, whose JSON `context` is forwarded to the authorizer, followed by the `image` part. The authorizer decides the namespace, the image ID, the size limit, the accepted formats, the variants and the notification. The image's format is detected from its content. The response is sent once the original is stored and its job is queued.

metadata.description: JSON object with an optional `context`, which must come before the image

post.summary: Upload an image from a browser
